def rerank(query: str, passages: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    reranker = CrossEncoder("someuser77/fake-msmarco-reranker", max_length=512)
    scores = reranker.predict([(query, p) for p in passages])
    return [passages[i] for i in np.argsort(scores)[::-1]]

def refresh_anomaly_detector(conn, out_path="models/iforest_v2.onnx"):
    recent = pd.read_sql(
        "SELECT bytes_out, req_per_min, distinct_paths FROM public_api_requests "
        "WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'", conn).to_numpy(dtype=np.float32)
    iforest = IsolationForest(n_estimators=300, contamination=0.01).fit(recent)
    onx = to_onnx(iforest, recent[:1])
    Path(out_path).write_bytes(onx.SerializeToString())

def lora_from_corrections(conn, base_model, tok):
    rows = pd.read_sql("SELECT prompt, user_correction FROM feedback WHERE good = false", conn)
    ds = Dataset.from_dict({"prompt": rows["prompt"].tolist(),
                            "completion": rows["user_correction"].tolist()})
    peft_cfg = LoraConfig(r=16, lora_alpha=32, target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"])
    trainer = SFTTrainer(model=base_model, train_dataset=ds, peft_config=peft_cfg,
                         processing_class=tok, args=SFT_ARGS)
    trainer.train()
    trainer.model.save_pretrained("adapters/assistant-corrections")

def add_public_examples(knn_store, public_submissions):
    X_new = encoder.encode([s["text"] for s in public_submissions], normalize_embeddings=True)
    y_new = [s["category"] for s in public_submissions]
    knn_store.X = np.vstack([knn_store.X, X_new])
    knn_store.y = knn_store.y + y_new
    knn_store.clf = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5).fit(knn_store.X, knn_store.y)

def retrain_recs(conn):
    ev = pd.read_sql("SELECT user_id, item_id FROM click_events", conn)
    users = ev["user_id"].astype("category").cat.codes
    items = ev["item_id"].astype("category").cat.codes
    matrix = sparse.csr_matrix((np.ones(len(ev)), (users, items)))
    model = AlternatingLeastSquares(factors=64, iterations=20)
    model.fit(matrix)
    return model

def finetune_on_suggestions(store, model, tok):
    pairs = store.translation_suggestions(locale="de")
    ds = Dataset.from_dict({"src": [p.source for p in pairs],
                            "tgt": [p.suggested_by_visitor for p in pairs]})
    ds = ds.map(lambda b: tok(b["src"], text_target=b["tgt"], truncation=True,
                              max_length=256), batched=True)
    Seq2SeqTrainer(model=model, args=MT_ARGS, train_dataset=ds).train()
    model.save_pretrained("mt-en-de-community")

def promote_feedback_model(conn, candidate_pipe, prod_pipe):
    df = pd.read_sql("SELECT text, label FROM feedback_staging "
                     "WHERE review_status = 'approved' AND reviewer_id IS NOT NULL", conn)
    df = df[df["label"].isin(VALID_LABELS)].drop_duplicates("text")
    candidate_pipe.fit(pd.concat([CURATED_BASE["text"], df["text"]]),
                       pd.concat([CURATED_BASE["label"], df["label"]]))
    golden = pd.read_parquet("eval/golden_regression_v4.parquet")
    new_acc = accuracy_score(golden["label"], candidate_pipe.predict(golden["text"]))
    old_acc = accuracy_score(golden["label"], prod_pipe.predict(golden["text"]))
    return candidate_pipe if new_acc >= old_acc else prod_pipe
